steps.input:
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    special = {v for v in counts if v not in (bg, line)}
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v in special for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in special for r in range(h))]
    # The marker lattice can include a trailing extension; use the compact rectangular region.
    if len(rows) > len(cols) + 1:
        rows = rows[:len(cols) + 1]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line_out = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            if len(set(corners)) == 1 and corners[0] in special:
                line_out.append(corners[0])
            else:
                line_out.append(bg)
        out.append(line_out)
    return out
'''
